title: 第三十章：交易•初识

第三十章：交易•初识

    贺峰听着这话便不由得皱起了眉头，因为从出生到现在他也没有见过自己这位爷爷，即便是奶奶也是没有见过的，他也一直以为他们已经死了的，贺峰对生命自然是没有什么敬畏之心的，因为他见过了太多的死人，也因为有很多的人死在了他的手中，但无论是以前还是现在，亦或是未来，都不会有人知道，这一切都是因为他生活的那片区域，叫做生死线。

    拼了命，然后活着，这便是生；拼了命，然后死去，这便是死；没有人会想自己死，他自然也不例外，所以他每次都拼了命的去让自己活着，这就叫做生死线。

    但仅管那两位至亲从没见过面，而现在确实有从别人的嘴里听到关于自己爷爷，这种感觉，他有些不喜欢。

    贺峰注意到，当林老问完这句话之后，父亲的脸上原本的笑意稍稍顿了顿，虽然谈不上悲伤，但那一瞬的落寞却是无法掩饰。

    “父亲他以前曾受过些伤，请尽名师，却终是无法痊愈，就连修为也开始不断的倒退，所以才想着要到一些地方闯荡一番，看能不能觅得一番生机，而一这走便是这些许年了，当年临走时约定的联络方式，这些年也一直没有出现过，更是没有听到过关于他老人家的任何信息，说起来倒是让林老笑话了，当年父亲落败并不是因为对手多么强大，而完全是因为当时父亲生了爱才之心，又疏于防备，而对方又出乎意料的是一位毒师，所以才••••••”

    贺峰听着这种有些悲伤又有些落寞的声音，哪怕他见惯了生死，甚至习惯了生死，但此时听着自己父亲那悲伤的声音，他竟也有些心酸的感觉，这种感觉让他感到陌生，因为太多年没有出现过这种感觉了；但他又有些熟悉，因为他曾有过这种感觉，而这种感觉一直藏在他的心底，从未暴露过，却也从未被抹除过。

    似乎所有令人刻骨铭心难堪回首的往事，都是发生在寒冷的雪天里，为什么呢？没人想过，或许也有人想过，但却没有答案，但那年，贺峰想过，而且有了自己的答案，并且，对这个答案他感到很满意。

    寒风如刀，刻骨。

    霜雪似剑，铭心。

    如此刻骨铭心，自然难堪回首，于是他便一路向前，不再回首，不是因为他的决绝，而是从那以后，他对以往再无留恋了，那年他对着那座坟拜了三拜，便斩了过往，断了回首。

    他以为自己再不会有心酸的感觉，今天却再次出现了。

    他以为自己再不会有悲伤的感觉，今天却又一次的出现。

    但他却没有任何的不喜，相反有些理所当然的感觉。

    贺烈说的事情特别平常，没有任何特别的地方，因为在光明之下，有一个词叫做“暗黑之刃”，所以没有人会怀疑，当然，也没有必要去怀疑。

    林老开始沉默，他知道这个组织，因为他也曾和这个组织打过交道，并且也知道这个组织有个很奇怪的规矩，叫做“九难归真”，这个词有着很复杂的意思，但其中最广为人知的一个意思便是：无论是出于哪一方面的原因，只要有人能够躲过暗黑之刃派出的九个杀手的刺杀，无论结果如何，此人便永远不会再出现在暗黑之刃的死亡名单上。除非有人主动去找暗黑之刃的麻烦，当然，这样做的人是少之又少的。

    贺烈在等林老说出那句话，所以他没有说话。

    林老则是因为无法代替韩家做什么决定，或者说承诺，所以他不知道该怎么说。

    苏馨大约已经猜出了林老为什么会到贺家来，可是她也并不十分确定贺烈有没有猜出来，而对于这种男人间的谈话，或者说交易，她是无法阻止的，也是不能阻止的。抬头看了看天色，便轻轻告了声退，开始吩咐准备上午的饭食。

Chapter 30: Trading•First acquaintance

    He Feng couldn't help but frown when he heard this, because he had never seen his grandfather since he was born, not even his grandmother, and he had always thought that they were dead. He Feng naturally had no respect for life, because he had seen too many dead people, and because many people died in his hands, but no one knew about it, whether before, now, or in the future. All of this was because the area where he lived was called the line of life and death.

    Fighting for one's life, and then living, this is life; fighting one's life, and then dying, this is death; no one wants to die, and he is no exception, so he tries his best to keep himself alive every time. This is called the line between life and death.

    But even though the two close relatives had never met, he did hear about his grandfather from other people's mouths. He didn't like this feeling.

    He Feng noticed that after Mr. Lin asked this question, the original smile on his father's face paused for a moment. Although it was not sad, the loneliness at that moment could not be concealed.

    "Father, he had suffered some injuries in the past. He sought out all the famous teachers, but he could not recover. Even his cultivation level began to decline continuously, so he thought about going to some places to see if he could find some life. It has been many years since he left, and the contact information agreed upon when he left has not been released in these years. I have seen it, and I have never heard any information about his old man. Speaking of which, it makes Mr. Lin laugh. My father's defeat was not because of how powerful his opponent was, but entirely because he was passionate about talents and neglected to take precautions. The other party was unexpectedly a poison master, so..."

    He Feng listened to this somewhat sad and lonely voice. Even though he was used to seeing life and death, and even accustomed to life and death, he felt a little sad when he listened to his father's sad voice. This feeling felt strange to him, because he had not felt this way for many years; but he was also familiar with it, because he had felt this way before, and this feeling had always been hidden in his heart. It had never been exposed, but it had never been erased.

    It seems that all the unforgettable and embarrassing past events happened in the cold snowy weather. Why? No one has thought about it, maybe some people have thought about it, but there is no answer. But that year, He Feng thought about it and had his own answer, and he was very satisfied with this answer.

    The cold wind cuts into the bones like a knife.

    Frost and snow are like swords, unforgettable.

    It was so unforgettable that it was naturally embarrassing to look back, so he moved forward and never looked back, not because of his determination, but because from then on, he had no nostalgia for the past. That year, he bowed three times to the tomb, then cut off the past and stopped looking back.

    He thought he would never feel sad again, but it happened again today.

    He thought he would never feel sad again, but today it happened again.

    But he didn't feel any displeasure. On the contrary, he felt that it was natural.

    What He Lie said was very ordinary and nothing special. Because under the light, there is a word called "Dark Blade", so no one would doubt it. Of course, there is no need to doubt it.

    Mr. Lin became silent. He knew this organization because he had dealt with it before, and he also knew that this organization had a very strange rule called "Nine Difficulties Return to True". This word has a very complicated meaning, but one of the most well-known meanings is: No matter what the reason is, as long as someone can escape the assassination of the nine killers sent by the Dark Blade, no matter what the result, this person will never appear on the death list of the Dark Blade again. Unless someone takes the initiative to cause trouble for Dark Blade, of course, there are very few people who do so.

    He Lie was waiting for Mr. Lin to say those words, so he didn't speak.

    Mr. Lin didn't know what to say because he couldn't make decisions or make promises on behalf of the Han family.

    Su Xin has probably guessed why Mr. Lin came to He's house, but she is not sure whether He Lie has guessed it, and she cannot stop or stop this kind of conversation or transaction between men. He raised his head to look at the sky, then quietly excused himself and began to give orders to prepare the morning meal.
